about_the_game:
BUNNY Soundtrack - A Unique Musical Experience

The BUNNY soundtrack is a special item created for fans of the game. It features a collection of songs sung entirely in acapella by children, offering a truly unique musical experience.

Features:

  • No instruments used—purely vocal performances

  • Short tracks that are concise yet impactful

  • Composed of 9 tracks that capture the distinct atmosphere of BUNNY's world

  • A creative and experimental approach to sound design, unlike anything else

This soundtrack is a dedicated release for the core fans of BUNNY. It stands apart from conventional music albums and is recommended only for those who have enjoyed and connected with the game. Dive into this one-of-a-kind musical journey and explore BUNNY’s imaginative spirit through sound.
